articles.title: Cyclone Akvan live tracker: Check latest updates
articles.description: Cyclonic Storm Akvan has intensified into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over the central parts of the South Bay of Bengal and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said in its latest bulletin issued on Wednesday, November 18.The storm moved very slowly north-northwestwards at around 3 kmph during the six hours preceding 5:30 am IST. It was centred near latitude 12.7°N and longitude 85.5°E, approximately 580 km east of Chennai, 650 km northeast of Trincomalee in Sri Lanka, 610 km southeast of Machilipatnam, 610 km south-southeast of Visakhapatnam and 730 km south of Gopalpur.The IMD has issued an Orange Message, indicating a cyclone alert for the Andhra Pradesh and adjoining South Odisha coasts.Continuing its north-northwestward movement, Akvan is likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon on November 20 as a Severe Cyclonic Storm. The system is expected to bring maximum sustained wind speeds of 100-110 kmph, with gusts reaching 120 kmph.Also Read: Man destroys $60 million US military aircraft in Ireland using an axe; photos show extent of damage— Indiametdept (@Indiametdept) The IMD has forecast that Akvan could cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon on November 20. At landfall, the system is likely to be a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm, with maximum sustained wind speeds of 120-130 kmph and gusts reaching 145 kmph.Cyclone Akvan live tracker: Latest updates on storm's pathThis section will be updated as the IMD issues fresh bulletins on the cyclone's position, direction, wind speed, intensity and projected landfall.November 18, 202611:21 am, November 18: Akvan moves at 3 kmph, remains hundreds of kilometres from Andhra Pradesh coastSevere Cyclonic Storm Akvan over the central parts of the South and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal continues to move very slowly in a north-northwestward direction at around 3 kmph.The cyclone is currently located around 580 km east of Chennai, 610 km southeast of Machilipatnam, 610 km south-southeast of Visakhapatnam and 730 km south of Gopalpur in Odisha.The IMD has forecast that the system will continue moving north-northwestwards before crossing the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon on November 20, with sustained wind speeds of 100-110 kmph and gusts up to 120 kmph.5:30 am IST: Cyclone Akvan intensified into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over the central South Bay of Bengal and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal. It was centred near 12.7°N and 85.5°E, moving north-northwestwards at 3 kmph during the preceding six hours. The IMD forecast landfall between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon on November 20, with sustained winds of 100-110 kmph and gusts up to 120 kmph.November 17, 202611:30 pm IST, November 17 (latest available update): Akvan was centred near 12.5°N and 85.6°E over the central South Bay of Bengal and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal. It moved northwards at 3 kmph during the preceding six hours.8:30 pm IST, November 17 (previous update): The cyclone was centred near 12.4°N and 85.6°E over the same region. It had moved north-northwestwards at 3 kmph during the preceding six hours.The next entry will be added here when a fresh IMD bulletin is issued.135945711Cyclone Akvan: Expected track and landfallNovember 18: Likely to intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over the Westcentral Bay of Bengal around morning.November 19: Expected to strengthen into a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm by evening while moving northwestwards.November 20: Likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon, with sustained winds of 120-130 kmph and gusts up to 145 kmph.Cyclone Akvan landfall forecast: Andhra Pradesh and South Odisha on alertThe IMD has identified the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coastline between Nellore and Visakhapatnam as the likely landfall stretch. The system is forecast to cross the coast around noon on November 20 as a Severe Cyclonic Storm.The latest forecast places the expected maximum sustained wind speed at 100-110 kmph, with gusts reaching 120 kmph. The IMD has issued an Orange Message for Andhra Pradesh and adjoining South Odisha coasts.The storm's location, intensity, movement and projected landfall timing will be monitored through subsequent IMD updates.
